mapper.select: SELECT NOTICE_NO noticeNo , NOTICE_TITLE noticeTitle , ENROLL_DATE createDate , VIEW_COUNT viewCount FROM CL_NOTICE WHERE STATUS='Y' ORDER BY NOTICE_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT N.NOTICE_NO noticeNo , M.MEMBER_ID noticeWriter , N.NOTICE_TITLE noticeTitle , N.ENROLL_DATE createDate , N.VIEW_COUNT viewCount , N.STATUS status , N.FIX fix FROM CL_NOTICE N JOIN CL_MEMBER M ON (N.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO) ORDER BY NOTICE_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
